stage: bounded follow-up; frozen before model/device calls
scope: offline candidate identity, input-contract scope, and work/resource relations; no runtime or operator edits
model_revision_limit: provider alias; immutable serving revision and reproducible server seed unavailable

conditions.D0: starting/historical evidence; correct abstention is accepted where current candidate evidence is absent
conditions.D1: D0 plus existing current raw source/compiler/validation artifacts and provenance; contract negative controls may have identical raw evidence
conditions.R: exact D1 raw facts plus deterministic, source-anchored entity relations; adds derived information, not a pure formatting treatment

retry: none; preserve provider errors/timeouts and count them as missing
isolation: existing deny-all pfdb-eval OpenCode agent; loaded permissions checked; fresh session per attempt; no files/tools visible
order: arm order rotated per base case, then the unchanged runner's replicate scheduling; no server-side randomization claim
scoring: frozen per-arm typed fields, valid fact references, minimum necessary evidence coverage; separate abstention, information recovery and unsupported claims
review: fresh reviewer sees anonymized public responses and their supplied evidence only; condition, deterministic scores and treatment mapping withheld; evidence content cannot itself be blinded

device_diagnostic.implementations: saved K256 non-scan c7ea6e parent and K256 scan 6fded candidate, identified through confirmation jobs and full source hashes
fixtures: one-request sorted gap512: arange512 with positions from physical index3 increased by1; position-dependent mappings/RoPE regenerated
device_diagnostic.oracle: unchanged canonical standalone golden and comparators; original inputs/builds remain untouched; private build copies
device_diagnostic.expected: both affine controls and non-scan gap control pass; scan gap may expose the skipped-index mechanism
device_diagnostic.interpretation: oracle-defined diagnostic only: skipped-position business-domain legality is unresolved; no timing or compiler-bug claim
device_diagnostic.execution: each fresh process under npu-run on logical device0; benchmark disabled; no automatic retry

stopping: run these attempts once; no adaptive repeats or new optimization search in this follow-up
implementation_gate: only minimal pfdb changes justified by results; do not add a generic IR engine, new tool family or acquisition to pfdb
claims_excluded: skipped positions are an established legal domain
compiled metadata hash uniquely identifies a build
preservation: do not edit previous frozen packets/results, original databases/captures/goldens, canonical operators or PyPTO/runtime
